justification: Image A depicts a carved standing figure with elaborate headdress, robe, floral rosettes and what appears to be an inscription panel, rendered in a schematic, incised low-relief style; Image B depicts a single sculpted human head/face emerging from a rough matrix, carved in a naturalistic, volumetric style with no accompanying figures, symbols or patterning. There is no shared subject matter beyond the broad category of 'human depiction,' and the specific motifs (headdress, robe folds, rosettes, script) in A have no counterpart in B, while B's isolated three-dimensional head has no counterpart in A's flat figural composition.
